rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hereditary nobles or the noble class.

example.english: That painting shows a group from the aristocracy.
example.jyutping: go2 fuk1 waa6 waa2 zyu6 jat1 baan1 gwai3 zuk6

rows.note: Use this in a political or historical context for government by aristocrats.

example.english: Historically, aristocracy meant that commoners had little say.
example.traditional: 歷史上，貴族政治令平民冇乜話語權。
example.jyutping: lik6 si2 soeng6 gwai3 zuk6 zing3 zi6 ling6 ping4 man4 mou5 mat1 waa6 jyu5 kyun4

rows.note: Use this for an elite class regarded as superior to ordinary people, without implying hereditary nobility.

example.english: The modern aristocracy of talent often thinks it is a cut above the rest.
example.traditional: 而家啲精英階層成日覺得自己高人一等。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 di1 zing1 jing1 gaai1 cang4 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 gou1 jan4 jat1 dang2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the wealthy or high-status section of society rather than an organized elite class.

example.english: Their family often mingles with the aristocracy.
example.traditional: 佢哋一家人成日同上流社會嘅人來往。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 seng4 jat6 tung4 soeng6 lau4 se5 wui6 ge3 jan4 loi4 wong5
